title: Ánh trăng trên hồ
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: moonlight on a still lake: gentle swells, the pad and the far choir, the music box improvising first, then the glass. G minor. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
